column1: # ZAP scan rule overrides for aster-cloud.
# Default action for all unlisted rules: WARN (set in workflow cmd_options).
# 10038 — CSP header     We set CSP in src/middleware.ts with a per-request
#                        nonce; ZAP can't follow nonced inline scripts so it
# 10054 — Cookie HttpOnly NextAuth's session-token IS HttpOnly + Secure +
#                        rotate through dev cookies that lack the flag.
# 90004 — Insufficient   This is the same finding as 10038 wrapped in a
#         Site Isolation different rule. Same false-positive.
# 10202 — Absence of     We have a separate CSRF mitigation via NextAuth's
#         Anti-CSRF      csrf cookie; ZAP can't see it for POSTs that
#                        don't have a literal `csrf-token` form field.
